_schema.purpose: Single source of truth for Graeham's brand identity. Every skill, every prompt, every output must read FROM this file rather than hardcoding values. Run scripts/verify_brand_identity.py before every push to catch regressions.
_schema.rule: Never hardcode DRE or contact info anywhere except this file. If a script generates output that includes brand details, it must read them from here at runtime.

identity.name: Graeham Watts
identity.title: REALTOR
identity._brand_rule: Graeham Watts is the PRIMARY brand and always leads, set largest. The attribution line sits beneath it, set SMALLER THAN THE NAME BUT STILL PLAINLY READABLE (roughly 15-17px against a 40px+ name, never a fine-print size). Use `brand_line` verbatim for footers and contact strips; use `brokerage` alone ('Compass') in structured fields and in legal/DRE advertising contexts, where the licensed broker must be named. Updated 2026-08-15 on Graeham's request to raise the team/brokerage prominence.
identity._brokerage_display_note: CORRECTED 2026-08-27, approved by Graeham. Was 'Compass Real Estate', set 2026-08-15 when he asked for a longer conversational form. That is the WRONG LICENSED ENTITY for California and must not come back. Compass's own DBA logo-architecture document maps California to plain 'COMPASS'; 'Compass Real Estate' is the licensed name for Idaho (submarkets other than Sun Valley), Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont and Wyoming. The document states that using the wrong name/logo can result in fines for BOTH the agent and Compass, because state real estate advertising law requires naming the brokerage the agent is actually licensed under. There is therefore no 'marketing form' of the brokerage name that differs from the legal one: in California it is 'Compass' in prose, in structured fields, and in DRE advertising contexts alike.
identity.brand_line: Powered by The Boyenga Team at Compass

_blocked_values._purpose: Values that must NEVER appear in any output. Audit script grep-fails on any of these.
_blocked_values._brand_blocklist_case_note: Brand values are matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY. This is deliberate: the 2026-08-13 migration used a case-sensitive pattern and silently skipped every ALL-CAPS 'INTERO' in the farming-postcard print templates and the offer-analyzer contact strips, leaving one client report with Intero in the header and Compass in the footer. Half-migrated is worse than un-migrated because it reads as done.
_blocked_values._brand_blocklist_entries_note: 'Berkshire Hathaway' was Intero's affiliate tagline and appeared on both faces of the printed farming postcard; Compass is NOT a Berkshire Hathaway affiliate, so this is a false affiliation claim on an unrecallable mailer. 'Martin Team' was a stale team name in the same postcard templates; the correct team is The Boyenga Team.
_blocked_values._brand_blocklist_note: Added 2026-08-13. Graeham moved to Compass; the former brokerage must not reappear in output. This is enforced the same way the wrong DRE is, because the same failure mode applies: a stale brand string buried in one reference file silently propagates into every generated report. A real instance of this existed in content-creation-engine/references/market-config.md, which not only hardcoded Intero but instructed the agent to 'correct' any occurrence of Compass back to it.
_blocked_values._misplaced_content_flag: NOTE: `online-content/` inside the SKILLS repo holds 12 tracked files of published content (switchy dashboards, a dated farming postcard). Skills/CLAUDE.md forbids this: 'Never put emails/newsletters/dashboards in Skills/'. It is exempted here only so the tripwire is not blocked by a historical artifact. The real fix is relocating it to the Graehamwatts/online-content repo, which is a decision for Graeham, not a silent cleanup.
_blocked_values._exempt_path_fragments_note: Substring matches against the file path. Exempts HISTORICAL RECORDS and GENERATED CACHES, never live source. Rationale per class: outputs/ and online_content_files/ are already-published artifacts (rewriting them would falsify what was actually sent); emails/ likewise; docs/ holds dated audit reports whose findings must stay as-found; graphify-out/ and ai-library/library/ are generated and regenerate from source. Live source files get NO exemption, which is the point: that is where a stale brand string would propagate into new client output.
